artifacts.summary: Six-phase, 9-hour plan landing the sorry-free de-risking round for the two open H/G rows (eight new declarations), recording Dense as expected-complete-no-obstruction and Dedekind as OPEN with the Doets D1/D2 obstruction named, and scoping the expensive remainder as follow-up briefs.

memory_candidates.content: Phase-decomposition strategy for 'decide an open metalogical question' tasks in this Lean tree, where the honest verdict is expected-but-unproved: do NOT plan a phase that states the headline theorem. Instead decompose into (1) sorry-free infrastructure that is reusable by any future proof route and is machine-checked evidence for the verdict, (2) machine-checked demonstrations that each already-closed row's separating witness fails to transfer to the open row, (3) a docstring-only phase recording the verdict plus the obstruction at declaration granularity (which declaration consumes which axiom that the target language cannot express), and (4) a final gate whose prohibition audit greps the whole diff for any theorem concluding in the forbidden statement. The expensive proof is scoped as a follow-up task, never as a phase. This keeps the Conservativity.lean 'never state a completeness theorem and discharge it with sorry' constraint mechanically enforced rather than merely intended, and it makes an OPEN verdict a committable, evidenced outcome instead of a stall.
